summary: LINGE GARTNERI (org. no. 983 565 069) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Fjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-08-15. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 01.240 (Dyrking av kjernefrukter og steinfrukter). CEO: Peder Iver Linge.
